title: Chapter 149 Power And Beauty
content:
Chapter 149 Power And Beauty

In this way, this order to mobilize the army in the east of Liaodong was taken into the hands of Zhong Yu.

And Zhong Yu also has it, and can easily win the support of the entire Liaodong. With these two pieces of paper, the more than 80,000 frontier troops in Liaodong can be easily defeated, and 1/3 of the army of Yan State is there.

After the death of Liaodong, Yan State not only lost a county, but also lost 1/2 of its territory and 1/3 of its army. His strength will be greatly weakened.

I can also gain the greatest strength with the smallest loss, swallow the entire Liaodong completely, and use Liaodong as a bridgehead for my attack on the Central Plains.

Put away the two orders in front of you, hand them into a scroll you prepared, put them in your arms, and keep them close to your body.

"Okay, since you listen to me so much, I'm not a person who doesn't believe what I say. Go away, and don't let me see you again, otherwise, you should know what will happen!" Standing up, Zhong Yu patted himself Some wrinkled clothes, ready to leave this place of right and wrong. After such a long battle, someone had already informed the defenders of the capital city of Yan.

At this moment, the soldiers on patrol must have arrived quickly, and if they don't leave now, it will be very difficult for them to leave if they want to leave.

Yanchun Jun, who had obtained Zhong Yu's permission, looked at the word in surprise, and seemed a little unbelievable. The vicious man in front of him would let him go so easily, and he was stunned for a moment, without any words. move.

"So, if I tell you to go, you still don't want to go? Do you want to save your life if you want to?" Looking at the two people in front of him, they still didn't leave after getting his order? Zhong Yu frowned.

"Yes, yes, my lord, let's go now, let's go now!" The two of Yan Chunjun shuddered when they heard this sentence, and they quickly replied, turned around after speaking, and walked out of the corridor in a panic. He ran, fell down on the way, and continued to run regardless of the pain in his body.

Seeing the two fleeing in embarrassment, Zhong Yu had a sly smile on his face, looked at their fleeing figures coldly, but thought of the reason for letting them go.

Although these two people gave themselves their Tiger Talisman Tokens, they didn't let others know when he ordered them to give them.

From a distance, he ordered the guards to block it, and he did not put down a layer of enchantment to ensure that no one else could hear what they said.

Therefore, the news of these two traitors is still very safe. As long as they are not stupid and don't tell the news, then they will still be the generals of the Yan State, and the Yanchun Lord who has power over the government.

It's just that the scandal of these two people today will be spread, causing the government and the people of Yan Kingdom to laugh, but for these two people, as long as their power and position are preserved, everything else is not important.

As long as they hold the power of the Yan Kingdom, who would dare to talk about them in front of them, or even openly discuss their embarrassing things today on the street? It's just a few curses in private, it's nothing to worry about, why bother!

And there are these two treacherous people on the court of Yan State, making wind and rain, making Yan State more and more dilapidated and corrupt. When he captures the country of Yan in the future, the resistance will be smaller.

And they can also threaten them with these two orders now, so that they will choose the main peace faction in the court of Yan State after they capture Liaodong.

Let King Yan choose to endure this tone, and instead repair with himself, no more wars, and admit the fact that he occupied Liaodong.

In this way, I can remember to Liaodong, and I don't have to worry about angering the country of Yan and causing a big war, so that I, who is still very weak, will suffer unnecessary losses.

The role of these two people is equivalent to that of Qin Hui in the later Song Dynasty to Dajin. People who are dedicated to traitors are more useful to themselves than 100,000 troops.

With them here, they can continue to sell the flesh and blood of Yan Kingdom to feed and strengthen themselves.

Withdrawing his thoughts, Zhong Yu turned his head to look at the Xuenv who was still standing in the hall: "Miss Xuenv, your peerless dancing posture just made me fall in love, and being interrupted by these villains really annoys me." , I am very sorry!"

"Your Excellency, you are admirable. The warriors under your command are the ones who open Xuenv's eyes. Such a brave man is unparalleled in the world!" With a few smiles, Xuenv replied unevenly.

Looking at the woman in front of him, she seemed to have been hurt and deceived by a man, and there was a faint trauma in her heart. She closed her heart to prevent all men from approaching, Zhong Yu laughed silently, and didn't care.

"Today's matter, after Yan Chunjun and his two go back, they will definitely search and arrest all the people involved in the case. There will definitely be no good end. As the girl Xuenv who caused this incident, she must bear the brunt of it. It is inevitable that Miss Xuenv will be killed. I dare you, please Miss Xuenv is with me, stay away from this place of right and wrong, and stay by my side, it will be extremely safe, and not let Miss Xuenv get hurt!" Zhong Yu invited, he was very amazed by Xuenv's dancing posture.

"Don't dare to bother your lord. How dare you trouble your lord with a lowly status. You have been involved in something just now. I already feel sorry for you. How dare you trouble your lord!" Is that really the case? This man took a fancy to his looks, and he was no different from Yanchun Jun, Xue Nu refused.

"Since this is the case, then I won't do much to keep you. I will leave. I hope Miss Xuenv will take good care of you all the way!" Zhong Yu replied bluntly, and Zhong Yu turned around and left.

He is not a saint of love, a person who wants to be lustful and desperate. Although the snow girl in front of him is beautiful, she dances all over the world, and has the potential to become a first-class master.

But so what?

In Zhong Yu's heart, Xuenv is still not as good as Liaodong, the territory of this province. That's a population of nearly 300,000, and an army of 80,000. They are opening their chests, waiting for themselves to accept it!

As for first-rate masters, there are hundreds of them in the world, and every month, first-rate masters are born and die. What I really value about Xue Nu is not her beauty, nor her martial arts, but his dancing posture that makes me overwhelmed.

With such an existence as a beauty, isn't there still a small number of imperial kingdoms? Although the number of beauties left in history during the Three Kingdoms period was much less when the world was destroyed, you can still find one or two if you search carefully.

What really attracted me was probably the throbbing left in my heart when I watched Qin Shimingyue when I was a child!

But this throbbing, the whole Qin Shimingyue gave herself to too many people, especially the number of women.

Shao Siming, Chi Lian, Luna, Shi Lan, Gao Yue...they can't count them all. When the imperial power becomes stronger in the future, who do you want for this woman in the Mingyue World of Qin Dynasty? It is not a matter of a word.

Under Yu Guo's iron hooves, no one can refuse his orders, including the current Snow Maiden.

As long as they have fetters in this world!
